verdict.score_rationale: The board lands at 6.5 because its orderly registers, clean routing, and flow-specific colors show deliberate composition, but broad dead bands, sparse oversized containers, and pervasive label truncation keep it from reading as fully finished.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: Failing: content spans most of the width, but the large gaps between rows and substantial empty area below the final section leave the locked frame underused.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Blue, teal dashed, purple, and orange consistently distinguish flow families, while the repeated yellow cards remain coherent rather than decorative.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair junctions, exposed waypoints, or ambiguous wire merges are visible; arrowheads terminate cleanly at section boundaries.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: The two main rows and bottom sequence hold strong horizontal registers, but uneven container widths, sparse interiors, and many ellipsized labels weaken the finished rhythm.
